A second full sampler resums arbitrarily many disconnected contributions in a supplied uniformly pin-Gram-controlled tensor representation. review.source_availability: Fixed balanced overlap excludes some allowed pure preparations/measurements, and the short-time window is not an all-time eta_sample. Restarting successive slabs discards a correlated quantum state. The rare-set bound is unconditional for fixed site sets: it supplies neither independent flags nor uniform estimates after arbitrary other pins, and small rare regions can couple through ordinary sites/histories. Uniform pin-Gram sampling requires its explicit representation; unpinned strong injectivity/BP fixed-depth strong-noise results do not establish arbitrary native pin stability. The Bell obstruction needs the stronger ALL-positive-endpoint-effect/common-linear-scalar/geometrically bounded physical representation; it does not rule out a representation only for one classical measurement law or establish sampling hardness. The negative-eta zero uses analytic continuation ONLY. It rejects one uniform eta=0-centered log disk over all early pins; easy native pairs and local exact resummation remain. An exact TP Doob gauge needs a positive invertible harmonic h_s solving K_s_star(h_s)+h_s_prime=0; K_s(I)=0 is a different property. Here h_s is the actual forward-evolved density operator, and the transformed initial pin is generally correlated/normalized; pure terminal preparation also needs paid regularization.
